notes.title: 1.86 patch note
notes.notes:
-Fixed some English translation lines (Mostly during the main game)
-Added 6 new playable songs to the One-on-one communication mode
Make sure you have installed the DLC 'Another Season Episode' in order to get this update.

notes.title: Patch note for ver 1.8
notes.notes:
♡beAt! Another Season Episode has now been updated to ver 1.8
Few changes includes:
-Bug fixed
-Adjustment for the Produce Mode
-Added 1 cg and short episode in Produce Mode
Happy Halloween y'all!

notes.title: Free DLC《♡beAt! Another Season Episode》 will be release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/69676929e0e8baf9553a71e177f81052d77bb6f5.png[/img]
The DLC will be including the stories of each members after the final concert of ♡beAt. The first chapter will be released on 8th March and the others will be updated in future.
Check for the store page for more info:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2335470/beAt_Another_Season_Episode/

notes.title: Announcement about the English version of the game
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, we're still haven't done with the translating, but we're working on it and probably will finish it in the few months.
Here the preview of the game, hopefully it'll be done before next year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/5b3db3aa9e10f01e0d5b727e73c4b8847dfd5d13.png[/img]

Thank you for keep following on ♡beat! -After the Summer- and we'll show more of the preview as we done.
